sources.title: Visa requirements for citizens of Uzbekistan
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Uzbekistan
sources.officialityEvidence: Uzbekistan MFA's live outbound-passport page was last updated 29 December 2025 and names visa-free and arrival-visa routes for Uzbek foreign-passport holders.
sources.supportingExcerpt: O‘zbekiston fuqarolari uchun to‘liq vizasiz kirish mavjud bo‘lgan davlatlar

policies.title: Uzbek ordinary passports: current visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Uzbekistan MFA's current outbound list expressly includes Grenada, Jordan and Ukraine among states granting Uzbek foreign-passport holders visa-free entry.
conditions: This is the listed ordinary Uzbek foreign-passport visa-free baseline; duration, purpose, carrier and final admission remain destination-specific.
Jordan's separately listed visa-on-arrival route does not displace the current visa-free option.

policies.title: Uzbek ordinary passports: current arrival-issued visitor visas
policies.summary: Uzbekistan MFA's current outbound list expressly places Comoros and Guinea-Bissau among states issuing a visa on arrival to Uzbek foreign-passport holders.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Uzbek foreign-travel passport for the listed short-visitor arrival-visa route; destination-specific fees, duration, documents and final admission remain applicable.
This policy does not infer arrival treatment for countries omitted from the current named list.

policies.title: Uzbek ordinary passports: current electronic visitor visas
policies.summary: Uzbekistan MFA's current outbound list expressly places Djibouti and South Sudan among states providing an electronic visa to Uzbek foreign-passport holders.
conditions: Use a valid ordinary Uzbek foreign-travel passport and complete the destination's applicable electronic-visa process before travel.
Purpose, duration, fees, supporting documents, carrier checks and final admission remain destination-specific.

conflicts.explanation: Uzbekistan MFA's current outbound schedule expressly assigns Djibouti to its electronic-visa group rather than its visa-on-arrival group.
